authoring_design.KG: One node per accepted fact, exact source-derived domains, 3–8 topical modules, source-supported confusable contrasts or explicit no-confusable reason, unknown official weights.
authoring_design.cards: Cloze retrieval fronts and at-most-six-word answer-fragment hooks; backs byte-equal accepted spoken statements. Any forbidden accepted string is preserved and merged only into a same-module sibling, with node/item/lesson refs retained.
authoring_design.exam_bank: One focal item per fact; two-claim comparison design recorded in each comparison-design-review.json. Practice forms disjoint by item id. Item-key checks do not clear inherited KG source-review flags.
authoring_design.sessions: One unit per module, six to eight slides, scope-based how-to application, worked comparison, correction, memory support and distinct self-check. Each fact appears in a source-bound why_how span.
authoring_design.card_scripts: Deterministic card and accepted teaching-span composition; exact front/back/hook parity, one shared silent-recall cue, 3000 ms pause as data, recap per deck. No audio rendered.
